_note: Development updates feed. Newest first. Append one object per milestone. Allowed tags: validation, filing, partnership, publication, hardware, site. Optional 'url' links out (or to an internal page). Keep 'summary' to 1-2 sentences.

updates.title: Site rebuilt on Astro with interactive NSL + DPI demos
updates.summary: pqsensing.com migrated to a static Astro build: live Noise-Stationary Locking demo with shareable-state URLs and a CSV bench-trace loader, a new dark-port matched-filter demo, typeset math, and a publications index.

updates.title: Three technical white papers published
updates.summary: Non-confidential papers on Noise-Stationary Locking + Dark-Port Injection, objective-function supervisory control modules, and atom-interferometric extensions are available with BibTeX citations.

updates.title: Seeking a validation partner for the tabletop MZI sprint
updates.summary: Actively looking for a university lab, metrology partner, or sponsor to run the first classical Mach–Zehnder comparison of a conventional lock against NSL under controlled disturbance.

updates.title: Standardized the bench-trace data format (PQS-Trace-v1.0)
updates.summary: The interactive demo now ingests measured (delta, P, N_band) traces directly, so validation-sprint data will map onto the published thesis with zero rework.
